title: Nvidia lost ~$1T in market value in less than two months, dropping 16% from its May all-time-high, trading at 18x forward earnings, its lowest level since 2019 (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Nvidia lost ~$1T in market value in less than two months, dropping 16% from its May all-time-high, trading at 18x forward earnings, its lowest level since 2019 — After losing roughly $1 trillion in market value in less than two months, Nvidia Corp.'s stock is the cheapest it's been since …
